question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the given word.

 Merciful
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Cruel)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Merciful"** means showing or exercising mercy or compassion towards someone. It is the quality of being kind and forgiving. (दयालु, कृपालु)

 
 
• **Example:** The merciful king pardoned the prisoner, giving him a second chance at life.
 
 
 
• **"Cruel"** means willfully causing pain or suffering to others, or feeling no concern about it. It is the opposite of being merciful. (क्रूर, निर्दयी)
 
 
• **Example:** The cruel dictator showed no mercy to his enemies and punished them harshly.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Merciful"** is **"Cruel"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Cruel)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cunning** (चालाक): Having or showing skill in achieving one's ends by deceit or evasion.

 
 
• **Example:** The cunning fox tricked the hunter and escaped into the forest.
 
 
 
• **Mild** (हल्का, सौम्य): Gentle and not easily provoked; moderate in action or intensity.
 
 
• **Example:** The mild weather today is perfect for a picnic in the park.
 
 
 
• **Magical** (जादुई): Relating to or resembling magic, enchanting or extraordinary.
 
 
• **Example:** The magician’s performance was truly magical and left the audience in awe.
